welcomeMessage: This website is provided as a public service by the South San Francisco Police Department. In an effort to protect victim privacy, this website does not provide information regarding juvenile offenders, or specific information regarding calls for service that are sensitive in nature. The South San Francisco Police Department does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of the information contained on this website regarding specific incidents, crimes, or people with respect to the omission of information that may have not yet been filed or is pending filing with a court of jurisdiction relating to criminal offenses. With regards to the people listed on the arrest page, arrests shown on that page are generated by arrests entered into the Records Management System at the South San Francisco Police Department and do not reflect all arrests in San Mateo County.

missingPersonsText: The South San Francisco Police Department is requesting your assistance in finding the individuals listed. If you have any information regarding their whereabouts, please call us at 650-877-8900.
stolenVehiclesText: Please DO NOT TAKE DIRECT ACTION if you see any of the stolen vehicles listed. If you see one of the vehicles listed, please call us at 650-877-8900. If occupied, call 9-1-1.
arrestText: This website offers the public an accessible and transparent way to stay informed about arrests made by the South San Francisco Police Department. It serves as a valuable resource for promoting community awareness. Arrest locations are approximate only. They are intended for general informational purposes and do not reflect the exact location. Individuals arrested are presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
crimeStatsDisclaimer: Crime statistics serve as an essential tool for comprehensively analyzing, interpreting, and responding to patterns of criminal activity within a society. The data presented in this report is dynamic and subject to ongoing revisions, as it is continuously sourced from the Police Department's Record Management System (RIMS) and updated on a daily basis.
stopDataStatsDisclaimer: Demographic information is recorded solely based on the officer's direct observation and initial perception at the time of the stop. It is not gathered through direct inquiry, nor is it derived from the individual's driver license or other forms of identification. As a result, the reported demographic details may not correspond with the individual's official documentation or self-identified characteristics.
stopDataStatsDefinitions:
Definitions

  1. Stops: A stop is any interaction between someone and a police officer, in which the officer detains the person or conducts a search — including pedestrian and vehicle stops.
  2. Location: South San Francisco police officers patrol South San Francisco, CA.
  3. Race or Ethnicity (Perceived): These race and ethnicity categories are defined by RIPA. The officer reports their perception of people they stop in these categories: White, Hispanic/Latino, Black/African American, Asian, Middle Eastern or South Asian, or Pacific Islander.
  4. Circumstance of the Stop: Was the stop a result of a call for service? If no, then the stop is deemed "officer initiated."
  5. Reason for Stop - Reasonable Suspicion: When the reason for a stop is categorized as “reasonable suspicion of a person involved in criminal activity,” then the officer also selects from several sub-categories: Actions indicative of casing, Carrying suspicious object, Indicative of engaging in violent crime, Matched suspect description, Officer witness (officer witnessed commission of a crime), Other (other reasonable suspicion), or Witness identification (witness or victim identification of suspect at scene).
  6. Reason for Stop - Traffic Violation: When the reason for a stop is categorized as "traffic violation," then the officer also selects from these sub-categories: moving violation, equipment violation and non-moving violation.
  7. Result of the Stop: Potential results of a stop include Warning, No Action, Citation for Infraction, Psychiatric Hold, Noncriminal/Car Transport, In-Field Cite and Release, Field Interview Card Completed or Custodial Arrest without Warrant.
